requirements.invariant: One browser request binds a stable Account and exactly one immutable Project-or-Business-Inventory scope. Route strings, copied project names, screen arrays, local row presence and provider identifiers cannot define or broaden scope.

The target browser converges the InventorySpacesSubTab and SpacesTabView active-list and stable-ID navigation responsibilities into one provider-neutral exact-scope path. Those source IDs remain source tracking evidence and are not claimed as new target implementation surfaces. CreateSpace remains separate; search and Item-count parity are deferred, and an unknown count must never render as zero.

The application list presents active Spaces only, with stable Space identity, canonical display name, exact scope and revision plus complete derived checklist completed/total counts. Archived lifecycle remains represented by underlying Space authority and exact detail but no archived list section is invented by this slice.

Waiting, cached or incomplete partial, stale, ready nonempty, authoritative empty and bounded failure remain distinct. Active exact membership plus fresh completion from this exact current-process space_browser subscription is required before zero rows can mean authoritative empty; generic database/connection status and assignment-stream completion are insufficient.

Every local row and completion sentinel is exact-Account and exact-scope evidence narrowed from signed Principal plus active membership. Missing, inactive, foreign-Principal, cross-Account, cross-scope, malformed, duplicate or incomplete evidence reveals no hidden rows/counts and cannot produce a mixed-trust snapshot.

Rows use one frozen deterministic case-insensitive name order with exact display name and stable SpaceID tie-breakers; duplicate names remain valid and identity is never display text or row position. This isolated staging foundation supplies the unsearched canonical row set and does not discharge the canonical production search-parity requirement; it defines no provider-side search authority.

The provider conforms only to the frozen Space browser query port. AppModel consumes Core snapshots only. Selecting a currently represented stable SpaceID derives the existing exact Account/Space SpaceCoreDetailsRequest; list refresh, deselection, scope replacement and cancellation cannot silently rebound an old selection or accept late detail evidence.

Encrypted restart may preserve valid cached rows and checklist evidence but resets current-process list completeness. Consumer cancellation, request replacement, membership loss and workspace close cancel and join list/detail observers and unsubscribe the browser stream before database close; no post-close watch or late emission succeeds.

This is a read-only isolated target slice. It adds no create/edit/archive/assign/checklist/media/Item/accounting command, MCP surface, hosted Sync/Auth action, Firebase behavior, source migration, production route, release or cutover authority; A-003/A-004/A-016 remain proposed until their separate gates pass.

Row-first and completion-first startup converge; cached rows survive encrypted reopen byte-identically while completeness resets; fresh exact-list completion restores ready or authoritative-empty state without fabricated progress.

Missing/inactive/foreign membership, cross-Account/scope, archived, malformed, duplicate, incomplete-child, overflow and failed evidence emits no mixed snapshot or false empty; cancellation, replacement and close drain all work and refuse late/post-close events.

The Core-only presenter exhaustively renders readiness, active rows and checklist progress; accepts only represented stable-ID selection; derives the exact existing detail request; generation-fences replacement, deselection and late list/detail events; and exposes no search surface.

An isolated user opens one Project or Inventory browser, sees honestly qualified active Space rows and checklist progress in stable order, selects by stable ID and opens the already-implemented exact detail flow with no mutation, search surface or provider leakage.

Project and Business-Inventory requests cannot cross Account or scope boundaries, local route/screen input cannot broaden visibility, and failures reveal neither hidden row counts nor provider details.

Concurrent browser/detail observations are leased by one Account workspace; request replacement, consumer cancellation and close cancel/unsubscribe/join deterministically; post-close watches refuse and reopen starts a fresh owner without late emissions.

Static stream-query inspection plus a controlled exact-subscription source prove that every query derives signed identity and active membership, narrows exact scope, returns only active Space/checklist progress evidence, establishes completeness only from its own current-process first sync and invalidates rows on membership/scope loss. This local proof cannot advance A-004; a real authenticated authorization/revocation/eviction rehearsal remains separately required before hosted or cutover readiness.
